about.title: About
about.story1: Founded with a vision to redefine luxury hospitality, {name} has been a beacon of excellence for discerning travelers from around the world. Our commitment to exceptional service, attention to detail, and genuine care for our guests sets us apart.
about.story2: Nestled in the heart of the city, our property combines timeless elegance with modern sophistication. Every corner of our hotel has been thoughtfully designed to create an atmosphere of refined comfort, where guests can unwind, rejuvenate, and create lasting memories.
about.story3: Whether you're here for business or leisure, our dedicated team is committed to ensuring your stay exceeds expectations. From our award-winning restaurants to our world-class spa, every experience at {name} is crafted to delight.
about.storyHeading: A Destination in the Heart of the Carpathians
about.value.excellenceDesc: Every detail — from room comfort to service speed — is held to the highest standard.
about.value.hospitalityDesc: Our team genuinely cares about making every guest feel at home from the moment they arrive.
about.value.natureDesc: Surrounded by the Carpathians, we help guests reconnect with nature, clean air and healing mineral springs.
testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real experiences from travellers who have stayed with us in the heart of the Carpathians.
testimonials.1.name: Anna M.
testimonials.1.text: Best hotel in Zakarpattia. The rooms are spotless, the staff is incredibly kind, and the location near Polyana is perfect for weekend getaways.
testimonials.2.name: Oleksiy V.
testimonials.2.text: We chose Hotel Continent for our anniversary and couldn't be happier. The suite was gorgeous and the team arranged every detail perfectly.
testimonials.3.name: Sarah L.
testimonials.3.text: Discovered this gem while travelling through Ukraine. Incredible value, great food, and a beautiful mountain setting. Will definitely return.
testimonials.4.name: Mykola H.
testimonials.4.text: Organised a team retreat here for 20 people. The banquet hall was excellent, rooms comfortable, and the Carpathian air did wonders for the whole team.

leisure.title: Local Recreation
leisure.subtitle: Discover the natural wonders and outdoor adventures surrounding Hotel Continent in the heart of the Carpathians.
leisure.mineral.title: Mineral Springs
leisure.mineral.desc: Polyana and the surrounding region are famous for their natural mineral waters with unique healing properties. Several sources are within walking distance of the hotel.
leisure.ski.title: Ski Resort
leisure.ski.desc: Kateryna (Polianski) and Play ski resorts are within easy reach. Enjoy groomed slopes for all skill levels, ski rentals, and certified instructors available through the hotel.
leisure.excursions.title: Guided Excursions
leisure.excursions.desc: Explore Uzhhorod Castle, ancient Carpathian monasteries, wine estates of Berehove, and scenic mountain passes. Our concierge arranges private and group tours daily.
leisure.atv.title: ATV & Off-Road
leisure.atv.desc: Conquer the Carpathian terrain on powerful ATVs. Guided off-road routes through forests, river valleys, and mountain ridges. Available for individuals and groups, no experience required.
leisure.thermal.title: Thermal Waters
leisure.thermal.desc: Soak in naturally heated thermal pools with mineral-rich waters at nearby Berehove and Kosino resorts. Known for therapeutic benefits for joints, skin, and the nervous system.
leisure.eco.title: Nature
leisure.eco.desc: Walk through pristine Carpathian forests, along a river, and through forests. Enjoy the true nature and landscapes.
leisure.cta.title: Ready to Explore?
leisure.cta.desc: Our concierge team can arrange any activity, transfer, or guided experience during your stay.
leisure.entertainment.title: Game Room & Entertainment
leisure.entertainment.desc: After a day of outdoor adventures, unwind in our dedicated game room. Enjoy a game of billiards, foosball, or simply relax in a cosy setting — right inside the hotel.
